title: RL-IF: Tracking Non-local Training Data Influence for Online Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28883v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success in decision-making tasks, but modern online RL remains highly sensitive to the quality of training experience. Understanding the contribution of individual training instances is therefore central to data-centric RL, with applications ranging from experience selection to policy interpretation. Existing data attribution methods for online RL primarily focus on local influence within a single training round, overlooking the non-local data influence across multiple training rounds. In this work, we formalize data attribution in online RL through a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, RL-LOO, which measures how one training sample influences a downstream target after subsequent online updates have taken place. translated_title: RL-IF：追踪在线强化学习中的非局部训练数据影响
translated_abstract: 在线强化学习在决策任务中取得了显著成功，但现代在线强化学习对训练经验的质量仍然高度敏感。因此，理解单个训练样本的贡献是以数据为中心的强化学习的核心问题，其应用涵盖从经验选择到策略解释等多个方面。现有的在线强化学习数据归因方法主要关注单个训练轮次内的局部影响，忽视了跨多个训练轮次的非局部数据影响。在这项工作中，我们通过一个轨迹级的留一量化指标 RL-LOO 将在线强化学习中的数据归因形式化，该指标度量了在后续在线更新发生后，某一个训练样本对下游目标的影响。随后，我们推导出 RL-IF，一个一阶估计器，它同时通过优化效应和策略诱导的采样效应两条途径传播数据影响，并提供了相应的理论（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出轨迹级留一指标 RL-LOO 及其一阶估计器 RL-IF，首次将在线强化学习的数据归因从单轮局部影响扩展到跨多轮的非局部影响，并同时刻画优化效应与策略诱导的采样效应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RL-LOO, a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, and RL-IF, a first-order estimator, to track non-local training data influence across multiple rounds of online reinforcement learning by capturing both optimization effects and policy-induced sampling effects.
